name: scholarocr
description: Source-traceable OCR for academic documents: scanned PDFs, page photos, handwriting, exam papers, equations and tables, with uncertainty labels and verification.

settings.name: Gemini API key
settings.description: Key ScholarOCR uses for page OCR when SCHOLAROCR_PROVIDER is gemini (the default). Leave empty if you use OpenRouter or a .env file in your workspace.

settings.name: OpenRouter API key
settings.description: Only needed when SCHOLAROCR_PROVIDER is openrouter. Leave empty otherwise.

settings.name: OCR provider
settings.description: gemini or openrouter. Leave empty for gemini, or to take it from your shell environment or workspace .env.
